english.title: Cause / attempt to cause / do an act calculated to cause disaffection / induce member of MOD police to withhold service
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[caused disaffection amongst the members of the Ministry of Defence Police]_
(B)_[attempted to cause disaffection amongst the members of the Ministry of Defence Police]_
(C)_[did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT..), calculated to cause disaffection amongst the members of the Ministry of Defence Police]_
(D)_[induced **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a member of the Ministry of Defence Police to withhold his service or commit breaches of discipline]_
(E)_[induced **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a member of the Ministry of Defence Police to withhold her service or commit breaches of discipline]_
(F)_[attempted to induce **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a member of the Ministry of Defence Police to withhold his service or commit breaches of discipline]_
(G)_[attempted to induce **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a member of the Ministry of Defence Police to withhold her service or commit breaches of discipline]_
(H)_[did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT..), calculated to induce **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a member of the Ministry of Defence Police to withhold his service or commit breaches of discipline]_
(I)_[did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT..), calculated to induce **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a member of the Ministry of Defence Police to withhold her service or commit breaches of discipline]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 6 of the Ministry of Defence Police Act 1987.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
